sources: Microsoft Learn: 'Powercfg command-line options', /hibernate off: turns off hibernation and removes the hibernation file hiberfil.sys. State detection through GetPwrCapabilities (SystemS4, HiberFilePresent), documented under 'SYSTEM_POWER_CAPABILITIES structure'.
The description only promises free disk space, not a speed gain.
measuredOn: Microsoft Learn: "Hibernation" (the hibernation file is about 40 percent of RAM by default; powercfg /hibernate off removes it)
